SECTION A — Section A - Objective (6 marks)
1. The decimal expansion of the rational number 11323 250 will terminate after (A) one decimal place (B) two decimal places (C) three decimal places (D) four decimal places  [1]
2. Two cones of equal heights have their radii in the ratio 3: 2. The ratio of their volumes will be equal to (A) 3: 2 (B) 9: 4 (C) 27: 8 (D) 81: 16  [1]
3. The area of a rhombus whose diagonals have lengths of 12 cm and 6.4 cm is (A) 768.0 cm2 (B) 384 cm2 (C) 38.4 cm2 (D) 76.8 cm2                                                                                                                                          (1 mark)  [1]
4. 1 If tanA=3/4, then CosA equals to (A) 4/5 (B) 3/5 (C) 4/3 (D) 3/4  [1]
5. If the sum of the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial 5x2 – kx + 7 is 4, ten find the value of ‘k.’ (A) 20 (B) 21 (C) 18 (D) 19  [1]
6. What is the perimeter of a quadrant of a circle (OAB) whose diameter is 10cm? (Use 𝜋= 3.14) (A) 7.85cm (B) 17.85cm (C) 27.85cm (D) 37.85cm  [1]

8. The traffic lights at three different road crossings change after every 48 sec, 72 sec and 108 sec respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 9:20:00 hrs, when will they again change simultaneously?   2)  [2]
9. If α and β are the zeros of the quadratic polynomial 2𝑥2 −8𝑥+ 5 , find the value of (𝛼+ 𝛽) × ( 𝛽+ 𝛼)   2)  [2]
10. Find the perimeter of an isosceles right triangle, the length of whose hypotenuse is 10 cm.   2)  [2]

12. The mean of the above distribution is 1.46; find the values of p and q.   3)  [3]
